targets.old_statement: A first license for someone under 65 runs eight years, a license for someone 65 or older runs four years, and an identification card runs eight years.
targets.old_spoken_statement: A first license for someone under sixty-five runs eight years, a license for someone sixty-five or older runs four years, and an identification card runs eight years.
targets.statement: A first-time license for someone under sixty-five runs eight years unless limited-term immigration documents set a shorter expiration, a license for someone sixty-five or older runs four years, and an identification card runs eight years.
